GENERATE BURST K4v-gen-cast-a — Run C-3 P5 frost bolt VFX sheet 'cast_00_03' (the run_03 method; charter § 3 fork B). task_id "K4v-gen-cast-a".

One image_gen call: Generate a painted FROST CAST VFX animation sprite sheet, exactly 2 columns × 2 rows of equal square cells, four frames in row-major order. Reference image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the icy blue-white energy at the character's staff tip, its faceted painted brushwork, hard illustrated edges and deep-blue falloff — do not include any character, hand, staff, scenery, symbols, text or grid. Pure uniform BLACK #000000 background, bright energy only (an additive emission plate). Every effect centred exactly in its own cell with generous black padding — no glow or particle touches a cell boundary. No photographic mist, neon laser style or fire-like flames. Frames 0–3 of 8: frame 0 a tiny gathering pale blue-white core with 3 small angular ice fragments, diameter 10 % of the cell; frame 1 a growing core with a few orbiting icy shards, 18 %; frame 2 a compact flare gathering bright layers, 28 %; frame 3 the peak crystalline cast flare with a brilliant pale-blue-white core and deep blue painted falloff, a few sharp shards pointing outward, 40 %. Genuine temporal growth of ONE effect.

ONE retry only if the grid is wrong, a character/staff/text appears, or the background is not black — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/cast_00_03.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K4v-gen-cast-a"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: STYLE ONLY — the frost energy at the staff tip
